name: skeleton
summary: The outline of something that is loading, in the place it will arrive.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: rect a block, text lines, circle an avatar, row a list row, card a card.

properties.name: lines
properties.description: How many lines a text skeleton stands for; the last of several is shorter.

properties.name: shimmer
properties.description: Whether it breathes after a second of loading. Never under reduced motion.

states.name: busy
states.description: Still for a second, then breathing; still under reduced motion.

accessibility.name: Loading, once for the group.
accessibility.web: A <span> with aria-hidden lines inside a busy region.
accessibility.apple: One element named Loading; its shapes are not read.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Text named Loading, not keyboard focusable.

cases.person: Three grey bars, the last shorter.

deviations: Sized with layout classes; native kits take a frame or a side.
